{{Top|leg}}

A '''pulse oven''' was a type of oven that heated food using a timer. It signaled that a meal was ready with a soft chime.<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade Skywalker's]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', had one installed in its galley.<ref name="Omen" />
